mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'priced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unpriceable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriceable, COALESCE(SUM(computed_credits), 0) AS computed_credits, COALESCE(SUM(upstream_user_credits), 0) AS upstream_user_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN upstream_user_credits IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS compared FROM billing_shadow_entries WHERE gmt_create >= #{from} AND gmt_create < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(usage_json, '$[0].modelId')), '(未知模型)') AS model_id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(usage_json, '$[0].taskType')), '(未知任务)') AS task_type, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM billing_shadow_entries WHERE status = 'unpriceable' AND gmt_create >= #{from} AND gmt_create < #{to} GROUP BY model_id, task_type ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT #{limit}
